The carry-forward source is the S113 EVOI-frontier workshop-campaign synthesis §3/§4: the YUKSHAPE R3 verdict (`ws-s113-7-yukshape`) converged BOTH poles onto a single hinge — doors D1–D3 of the SHAPE-branch four-door disjunction are CLOSED by permanent theorems + machine-exact operator checks, leaving exactly ONE structurally-distinct open door (D4, the right-regular SU(3)_R connection). The DMMASS R3 verdict (`ws-s113-4-dmmass`) converged on a single open dimensionless sub-question doubly-scoped by a provenance precondition.

Three gates, each with an independent verdict:

- **W3-1 `CF-S114-YUK-RIGHTREG-CONNECTION`** (connes-ncg-theorist) — the D4 decider: construct the right-regular generation operator `Y_R = Σ_a c_a R_{X_a}` on the multiplicity leg `ℂ^{m(p,q)}` and run the 4-part discriminator (i left-inv / ii sign-changing on the `t`-leg / iii BDI off-diagonal survival / **iv load-bearing**: `Y_R ∈ closure(Ω¹_{D_K}(A_K))` external vs substrate-internal SU(3)_R-bundle connection). PASS(iv-internal) ⇒ an off-Casimir route exists, the SHAPE-wall theorem (W3-3) gains the `A_K`-LEFT-built scope qualifier; FAIL(iv-external) ⇒ D4 closed, the genus is COMPLETE; INFO(iv-convention-dependent) ⇒ representation-pinning workshop. Dual prior 0.40 internal / 0.60 external.
- **W3-2 `CF-S114-LEGGETT-INTERBAND-25P5`** (landau-condensed-matter-theorist) — the open DM dimensionless corridor: compute the Leggett-branch B2⊕B3 inter-band BdG coherence-mode frequency `ω_Leggett^{B2-B3}` on the FULL sector at τ_fold, with a **Z₂-pre-flight that HARD-GATES** the [24,27]-band evaluation, plus a clause-α provenance sub-check (is 25.5×Δ_BCS a DM requirement or solely the n_s Wall-W9 transplant). 3-outcome: PASS (Reading-A Leggett moment) / FAIL (Reading-B Higgs-amplitude-branch only) / INFO (mis-attribution).

**Wave-order note**: W3-3 lands the CLOSED-class theorem (D1–D3); its scope-qualifier text references the open D4 channel that W3-1 decides. W3-1 and W3-3 are STRUCTURALLY INDEPENDENT at compute time (W3-3's theorem is the closed class; the D4 verdict from W3-1 does NOT change what W3-3 registers — it only determines whether a FUTURE session upgrades the wall from `A_K`-LEFT-scoped to unconditional). substitution_chain:

  content: |
    Claim (discriminator ii): "Y_R can have a SIGN-CHANGING generation-eigenvalue pattern across the
    t = 0,1,2 multiplicity copies (non-uniform-sign on the generation leg)."

    PRE-FLIGHT (selection-rule / center-character, MANDATORY per math-scripts.md §"Selection-rule pre-flight

      Step 0a (center characters): SU(3) triality t(p,q) = (p−q) mod 3. The right-regular generator R_{X_a}

        NOT a squared-modulus dressing |f|². Its center character is t(R_{X_a}) = t(X_a):
          - Cartan generators (R_{H_1}, R_{H_2}): center-NEUTRAL, t = 0 (the Cartan torus is in the maximal
            torus, triality-preserving) ⇒ admissibility t(copy_i) == t(copy_j) + 0 (mod 3) ⇒ DIAGONAL on the
            triality grading (connects each t-class to itself) — admissible to act WITHIN each t-copy.
          - Root generators (R_{E_α}): center character ±1 (raise/lower triality) ⇒ connect t-class i to
            t-class i±1 — admissible only for OFF-DIAGONAL (cross-generation) matrix elements.
      Step 0b (admissibility verdict): for the SIGN-CHANGING per-generation eigenvalue pattern, the operative
        construction is the CARTAN combination Y_R = Σ_a c_a R_{H_a} (center-neutral, t(O)=0). This is
        admissible: t(copy_i) == t(copy_i) + 0 holds trivially ⇒ the Cartan right-generator CAN act non-zero
        on each generation copy. The check PASSES (necessary condition satisfied), so the "non-scalar /
        sign-changing" claim is NOT group-theoretically inadmissible — UNLIKE a squared-modulus |f|² operator
        (which is ALWAYS t(O)=0 but is also ALWAYS Schur-scalar on the multiplicity commutant; the distinction
        is that R_H is a genuine SU(3)_R generator on the leg, NOT an A_K-built |f|²). The pre-flight here
        CONFIRMS admissibility; it does NOT certify the element non-zero (necessary, not sufficient) — the
        numerical eigenvalue computation (ii) is what decides the sign-flip.

    Step 1 — Definitions:
      ℂ^{m(p,q)} = Peter-Weyl multiplicity leg of sector (p,q), dim = dim(p,q)  [dirac_spectrum.py docstring
        lines 11, 1367-1369: L²(SU(3),S) = ⊕_π V_π ⊗ ℂ^16, multiplicity = dim(p,q) from left-regular rep]
      R_{H_a} = right-regular Cartan generator on ℂ^{m(p,q)}  [NEW construction; right-translation analog of
        the existing left su3_generators()]
      eig_t(Y_R) = the eigenvalue-vector of Y_R restricted to the t-th generation copy, t ∈ {0,1,2}
      sign_flip(eig_t) := TRUE iff sign(eig_0), sign(eig_1), sign(eig_2) are NOT all equal
    Step 2 — Substitution (the discriminator into the SU(3)_R weight structure, no simplification):
      Y_R |t-copy⟩ = (Σ_a c_a R_{H_a}) |t-copy⟩ = (Σ_a c_a · w_a(t)) |t-copy⟩
        where w_a(t) is the a-th Cartan weight of the t-th multiplicity copy under the right SU(3)_R.
    Step 3 — Simplification (algebra only, one step per line):
      eig_t(Y_R) = Σ_a c_a · w_a(t)                                   [Cartan eigenvalue = weighted sum of weights]
      = c · w(t)                                                       [inner product of c-vector with the weight at copy t]
      The three generation copies t = 0,1,2 carry DISTINCT right-SU(3)_R weights w(0), w(1), w(2) (the
        right-regular weights are the conjugate-rep weights of the multiplicity copies — Peter-Weyl).
    Step 4 — Direction read-off (from canonical form):
      For a generic BDI-real Cartan c-vector, c·w(0), c·w(1), c·w(2) are three distinct reals whose SIGNS need
      NOT agree (the weights w(t) live in distinct triality cosets of the weight lattice). Whether a sign flip
      OCCURS for the structurally-natural BDI-real c is a NUMERICAL question (the weights are fixed; the sign
      pattern depends on c). The substitution chain establishes that a sign flip is ADMISSIBLE and NOT
      forbidden by Schur (R_H is NOT A_K-built, so the multiplicity-scalar lock of D1–D3 does NOT apply) —
      it does NOT pre-determine that the flip occurs; (ii) measures it.
    Conclusion: discriminator (ii) [sign-changing on the t-leg] is group-theoretically ADMISSIBLE (center-
      character pre-flight PASSES; not Schur-locked because R_H ∉ A_K-image); the sign-flip boolean is an
      OUTPUT of the numerical Cartan-eigenvalue computation, not a claim asserted here. The load-bearing
      verdict is (iv) — whether this admissible non-scalar operator is reachable from A_K's LEFT calculus
      (external) or is a genuine right-bundle connection (internal candidate).

    Step 1 — Definitions:

      machine-exact verifications the landing reproduces (exact rationals confirm 0, ruling out round-off).
    Conclusion: D1 is CLOSED by the permanent anticommutator {γ₉,D_K}=0 — connes's R1 orientation-slope
